card.name: Effectiveness and success of programs
card.fires_on: Words like effective, effectiveness, effectively, successful and failed when judging whether a policy, program or intervention works. Often follows 'has not been' or 'the' or 'for'.

modes.label: Effectiveness noun
modes.description: The noun effectiveness (or its ending) about how well a program or policy works.

modes.label: Has not been effective
modes.description: An adjective or verb of success or failure after 'has not been' or 'have'.
modes.example: the data say it simply hasn't been<< effective>> in improving student behavior or ensuring school safety

card.plain: It marks words that judge whether a program or policy actually works.
